# agent-rules (agent-rules-tui)

> Discover, browse, and edit AI coding agent instruction files from your terminal.

## Overview

agent-rules is a focused terminal UI built with Go and Bubble Tea to manage rule, system prompt, and agent memory files scattered across projects.

- **Website**: https://agent-rules-tui.pages.dev/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/natelindev/agent-rules-tui
- **License**: MIT
- **Requirements**: Go 1.24+

## Supported Agent Instruction Files

- **Cursor**: `.cursorrules`, `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`
- **Claude Code**: `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/*.md`
- **GitHub Copilot**: `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
- **Windsurf**: `.windsurfrules`
- **Google Antigravity**: `AGENTS.md`, `.gemini/rules/*`
- **OpenCode & Custom**: `SYSTEM_PROMPT.md`, `PROMPT.md`, `INSTRUCTIONS.md`, `.rules`

## Installation

```bash
# Via Go
go install github.com/natelindev/agent-rules-tui/cmd/agent-rules@latest

# From source
git clone https://github.com/natelindev/agent-rules-tui.git
cd agent-rules-tui
go build -o ./bin/agent-rules ./cmd/agent-rules
```

## Navigation & Keybindings

- **Up / Down, j / k**: Navigate files and projects.
- **Enter / Space**: Open/expand project or edit selected rule file in configured editor.
- **/**: Filter rule files by name or content.
- **Tab**: Cycle focus between tree and preview panel.
- **e**: Edit rule file directly in `$EDITOR`.
- **r**: Rescan projects and refresh rule file list.
- **q / Ctrl+C**: Quit application.

## CLI Flags

- `--path / -p <dir>`: Root directory to scan for projects and agent rules.
- `--editor / -e <cmd>`: Override default text editor (defaults to `$EDITOR` or `nano`/`vim`).
- `--global / -g`: Include user home global agent configuration files.
- `--version`: Print application version.
- `--help`: Display usage and flag reference.
